 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz Winwyn Marques, Mikee Quintos, more Kapuso stars join 'Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0' 
 By GMA News Published October 24, 2026 7:52pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photos: GMA Network/FB Some Kapuso stars surprised "Pinoy Big Brother" fans as they entered Bahay Ni Kuya for the newest season on Saturday.
 Winwyn Marquez, Mikee Quintos, Anthony Constantino, and Raheel Bhyria were revealed to be among the 16 housemates of "Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0."
 Also among the housemates are Star Magic stars including Cianne Dominguez and Robbie Jaworski, as well as former UNIS member Gehlee Dangca, and ordinary individuals who passed the auditions.
 The hosts said that two of the housemates will have a special participation in the show as Kuya's collaborators.

 " PBB Collab 3.0 " premiered on October 24 on GMA Network where it showed the viewers the new look of Bahay ni Kuya.
 Brent Manalo and Mika Salamanca were hailed as the Big Winner duo of the inaugural "PBB: Celebrity Collab Edition."
 In February, Caprice Cayetano and Lella Ford emerged as the Kapuso and Kapamilya Big Winners of "PBB: Celebrity Collab Edition 2.0." —Jade Veronique Yap/JCB, GMA News
